died.name: Victims of the 1930 crash of the British R101 airship
died.cause: Victims of the 1930 crash of the British R101 airship included designers Vincent Crane Richmond and Michael Rope, along with Secretary of State for Air Lord Thomson who proposed the voyage, Air Vice Marshal Sir Sefton Brancker, responsible for its safety certification, and Director of Airship Development Reginald Colmore, who had managed its construction and overruled a safety inspection that recommended rebuilding.
